posts.title: Open Source as We Know It Is Dead
posts.description: I've been part of open source for most of my life. This year, the projects I love started closing their doors to outside contributors, and I don't blame them one bit, but it makes me sad. A personal look at how AI is changing open source as I've known it.

posts.title: Run Express.js on Cloudflare Workers
posts.description: Learn how to run express.js natively on Cloudflare Workers, with improved Node.js compatibility.

posts.title: Compressing assets with Zstandard and Webpack
posts.description: Learn how to build compressed zstandard (zstd) assets with webpack and CompressionWebpackPlugin.
